description: ADA dental claim form: the section titles are set in runs of a letter or a few, with box gaps of up to 0.22 em inside words. They read as whole words, and a glyph the PDF hands to an /ActualText span leaves no space inside its word ("treatment"). The section bars inside the form table are headings in their cells, and the Contents lists them (#163). A table cell keeps the case of the text layer: the cells' reader mapped the small-capital glyphs one by one ("COVERAgE"), where /ActualText says "other coverage" (#164). The ruled grid of the whole page is a form layout, not a table (#281): it reads as one column of section headings, each box's caption in the form's printed numbering (1 to 58), and its choices as check boxes in a fieldset under the caption (7 Gender, 10 and 18 Relationship). Only the record of services stays a table, its header row over lines 1 to 10. The two lines of the 52 Phone Number box, set 3 pt apart, are not mixed character by character.
